[attribute-object-type]
=== `@object-type` Object Type (in Related Object)

Type of object (for example, “`table`”, “`figure`”, “`sidebar`”) that is the target of the <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>> element.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Names the type of related object, such as “table”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
